title: file split

messages.description: file or directory name to split
'/' if the input ends with '/', bang otherwise

body: [file split] splits a path into a list of its components. No checks are made on whether the path is valid or exists. It always outputs symbols, even if a component looks like a number: that makes them harder to [route], but keeps zero-padded numbers intact (think "2020/01/01/0042.wav").
